caption: The drawing depicts two metallic objects on a plain, light beige background. The object on the left is shorter, consisting of a round, flat base, a thin stem with a baluster-shaped segment, and a wider, bell-shaped upper section that appears to contain three protruding stick-like elements at the top. The object on the right is taller, featuring a wide, conical base, a slim, straight stem with two ring details near the midpoint, and an upper portion shaped like an inverted bell with a slight dome on top and a small knob at the very top center. Both objects are rendered in shades of gray and metallic blue, with highlights and shadows suggesting a reflective, metallic surface. The objects are arranged vertically, standing upright, and positioned side by side, with the shorter object on the left and the taller one on the right.
title: Two Oil Lamps
